title: Consider hiding the status bar for full-screen media

statement.en: Consider temporarily hiding the status bar for full-screen media.
statement.ja: full-screen mediaの表示中はstatus barを一時的に隠すことを検討する。

conditions: Temporary hiding can reduce distraction and make the media experience more immersive.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable Status bars experience on the scoped Apple platforms.
rationale.ja: この指針は、対象AppleプラットフォームにおけるStatus barsの一貫性と使いやすさを支えます。

manual: Does the design satisfy “Consider temporarily hiding the status bar for full-screen media.” in the documented Status bars context?

anti_patterns: Ignoring this guidance in a context where the source section applies.
positive_examples: A design review records how the implementation satisfies this rule and any source-scoped exception.

source.evidence_paraphrase: Consider temporarily hiding the status bar for full-screen media.

apple_native_rule: Consider temporarily hiding the status bar for full-screen media.
portable_interpretation: Preserve the user-centered intent after replacing Apple-specific platforms, components, and input conventions.

title: Avoid permanently hiding the status bar

statement.en: Avoid permanently hiding the iOS or iPadOS status bar.
statement.ja: iOSまたはiPadOSのstatus barを恒久的に隠さない。

conditions: Provide a simple, discoverable gesture that restores a temporarily hidden status bar.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable Status bars experience on the scoped Apple platforms.
rationale.ja: この指針は、対象AppleプラットフォームにおけるStatus barsの一貫性と使いやすさを支えます。
